runtime.compose_yaml:
name: wishicraft-host-runtime
services:
  minecraft:
    env_file:
    - runtime.env
    environment:
      LEVEL: ${WISHICRAFT_PACKAGE_LEVEL:-world}
      NEOFORGE_FORCE_REINSTALL: ${WISHICRAFT_PACKAGE_NEOFORGE_FORCE_REINSTALL?verified
        package required}
      NEOFORGE_INSTALLER: ${WISHICRAFT_PACKAGE_NEOFORGE_INSTALLER?verified package
        required}
      NEOFORGE_VERSION: ${WISHICRAFT_PACKAGE_NEOFORGE_VERSION?verified package required}
      PAPER_BUILD: ${WISHICRAFT_PACKAGE_PAPER_BUILD:-}
      PAPER_CUSTOM_JAR: ${WISHICRAFT_PACKAGE_PAPER_CUSTOM_JAR:-}
      SKIP_DOWNLOAD_DEFAULTS: ${WISHICRAFT_PACKAGE_SKIP_DOWNLOAD_DEFAULTS:-false}
      TYPE: ${WISHICRAFT_PACKAGE_TYPE?verified package required}
      VERSION: ${WISHICRAFT_PACKAGE_VERSION?verified package required}
    image: ghcr.io/itzg/minecraft-server:2026.7.2-java25@sha256:6ec1110e4d9236d00ae9436a3e4a5929583e5b19cc94b756a7c603f7cf647a77
    labels:
      com.wishicraft.active-game-data-source: ${GAME_DIRECTORY:?targeted Game required}
      com.wishicraft.active-game-id: ${WISHICRAFT_GAME_ID:?targeted Game required}
      com.wishicraft.package-digest: ${WISHICRAFT_PACKAGE_DIGEST:?verified package
        required}
      com.wishicraft.run-id: ${WISHICRAFT_RUN_ID:?targeted START required}
    mem_limit: 6144MiB
    ports:
    - 25565:25565/tcp
    pull_policy: never
    restart: 'no'
    stop_grace_period: 150s
    volumes:
    - bind:
        create_host_path: false
      source: ${GAME_DIRECTORY:?targeted Game required}
      target: /data
      type: bind
    - bind:
        create_host_path: false
      read_only: true
      source: ${GAME_PACKAGE_DIRECTORY:?verified package required}
      target: /wishicraft-package
      type: bind
    - read_only: true
      source: /run/wishicraft/rcon-password
      target: /run/secrets/rcon-password
      type: bind
    - read_only: false
      source: /run/wishicraft/rcon-cli.env
      target: /data/.rcon-cli.env
      type: bind
    - read_only: false
      source: /run/wishicraft/rcon-cli.yaml
      target: /data/.rcon-cli.yaml
      type: bind
runtime.runtime_env:
ENABLE_RCON=true
EULA=TRUE
GID=993
INIT_MEMORY=1G
MAX_MEMORY=4G
RCON_PASSWORD_FILE=/run/secrets/rcon-password
SKIP_CHOWN_DATA=true
STOP_DURATION=120
UID=993
